editorial.blurb: A hidden gem ramen spot where the chef-owner works tirelessly to deliver perfectly calibrated bowls and crispy potstickers that keep Chicago ramen lovers coming back.
editorial.insiderTip: Build your own ramen with miso broth, karaage chicken, soft noodles, and 2 cloves of garlic with light sodium—it's the formula that converts even picky eaters. Go during off-peak hours to snag a seat, as this tiny spot fills up fast.
